text:
Priya: Heads-up 5min ago we saw a flurry of cross-region retries from ap-south -> us-west, manifests as increased client retries and sporadic TLS handshakes failing.
Dev: Any indication if this is config drift or a transient route flap?
Priya: Initial look: control-plane pushed a route rewrite that briefly preferred a legacy POP; at same time some edge boxes reported `tls: handshake error: local certificate expired` in a subset of pods. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-24T02:10:02Z] edge-proxy ERROR tls: handshake error: certificate expired for cert-id=xyz
[2026-03-24T02:10:02Z] traffic-router WARN selected backend region=us-west via legacy-pop latency=360ms
```
Ravi: I'll take ownership of the cert inventory check and patch any expired CA chains. ETA 6h.
Sam: I'll own correlation analysis across incidents: this looks like pattern #4 in our recurring list (route-flip + TLS jitter). I'll update the recurring-incident doc and recommend mitigations. ETA 72h.
Priya: Action items: 1) Ravi cert sweep + hotfix 2) Dev route rule rollback safety net 3) Sam incident pattern write-up 4) Add alerting for cert expiry and route divergence.
Dev: I'll open a PR to add a route-divergence guard to the control-plane: detect >2% regional deviation within 5m and stop automated rewrites. Plan a canary tomorrow 07:30 UTC at 5% traffic with 20m watch.
Ravi: Patched 2 edge nodes; pushing CA bundle rotation across remaining nodes now. Will post PR and rollout link.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2375. Pager: oncall@redwood with severity=P3. Postmortem template: https://redwood/inci/INC-2026-2375/postmortem
Priya: Sam please include whether our client-side retry backoff params (max attempts=5, backoff=exponential(base=250ms)) are amplifying user-visible retries. If so, we should propose client-side recommendations.
Sam: Noted. Also adding KV cache invalidation as a hypothesis 5% of requests hit stale routing keys after flip. Will instrument.
Dev: For rollout: will add an automated rollback criterion: if cross-region 5xx >0.8% for 10m, rollback immediately. Opening RFC: https://redwood/rfcs/route-guard-2026 and PR link: (coming).
Ravi: CA rotation PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ca-rotate/pull/512. Started phased rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks.
Priya: Dashboard owners, please add a chart for per-region TLS error rate and a diff view for route selection. Link to new dashboard stub: https://grafana/redwood/d/tls-route-diff.
Sam: Scheduling a 30m follow-up tomorrow 08:00 UTC to review rollout and pattern analysis. Please confirm owners add checkboxes to INC-2026-2375.
Dev: Confirmed.
Ravi: Confirmed.
Priya: Confirmed.
Sam: Will produce a short executive summary after the follow-up with remediation owners and timelines.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Let's make sure we capture lessons: avoid simultaneous control-plane rewrites during cert churn windows. :checkered_flag:
